# TradeOn Global

> TradeOn Global (tradeon.global) is a Bangladesh-based storefront that resells
> wholesale products sourced from 1688.com and Alibaba. Shoppers browse or search the
> upstream catalogue in English, see prices converted to Bangladeshi Taka (BDT), and
> order for delivery from China to Bangladesh.

Prices are shown in BDT, converted from the supplier's CNY price at the site's current
rate and markup. Product listings, images, and stock are sourced live from the upstream
1688 catalogue, so individual product URLs are not stable and are not listed here.
Typical delivery is 10-12 days from China to Bangladesh.

## Pages

- [Home](https://tradeon.global/): Product search, trending products, and category browsing.
- [About Us](https://tradeon.global/about-us): Who TradeOn Global is and how the service works.
- [Contact Us](https://tradeon.global/contact-us): Head office address, email, and phone.
- [Prohibited Items](https://tradeon.global/prohibited-items): Categories that cannot be ordered, including tobacco, alcohol, drones, weapons, and hazardous chemicals.
- [Return & Refund Policy](https://tradeon.global/return-refund-policy): Conditions and process for returns and refunds.
- [Privacy Policy](https://tradeon.global/privacy-policy): What customer data is collected and how it is used.
- [Install the App](https://tradeon.global/install): Installing TradeOn Global as a progressive web app.

## Optional

- [Sign In](https://tradeon.global/auth): Account sign-in and registration. Ordering, the cart, and the wishlist require an account.
